# Care Gap Closure Agent — Production Runbook

> **Scenario**: Care Gap Closure Agent
> **Platform**: Microsoft Copilot Studio — GitHub Copilot harness
> **Target readers**: Makers, delivery engineers, customer or partner operators

**Estimated effort**: Not yet measured; record actual effort on the Frontier Clock.

**Template:** an example to modify for your requirements; the customer or partner wires it into their environment. See the [Overview](1.Overview.md).

## Prerequisites

| Requirement | Details | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Build workload | 18 captured build checkpoints; 4 skills; 2 knowledge files; 5 acceptance checks; 4 locked cases. [Inventory](2.Architecture.md#copilot-studio-components), [checks](0.Resources/README.md#template-acceptance-checks), and [cases](4.Sample-prompts.md#demo-prompts). | Template |
| Licensing and capacity | Confirm tenant licensing and Copilot Credits for the GitHub Copilot harness; building, Preview and evaluation consume credits before publication. | Customer or partner |
| Environment and maker access | Record the approved environment, publisher prefix and maker access; use `cli-copilot` authoring and keep the workshop synthetic and Draft. | Customer or partner |
| DLP and data policy | Have the administrator review policies for uploaded quality files, proposed care-coordination and clinical sources, and the intended channel; document blocked paths. | Customer or partner |
| Identity and audience | Review the supplied GroupMembership access policy, Integrated authentication and Always trigger; record who may build, test and use the agent. | Customer or partner |
| Connection ownership | Name owners for the Dynamics 365 care-coordination workflow and Microsoft Teams review and approval. The workshop needs no customer connection. | Customer or partner |
| Test identities | Prepare quality, care-coordination, clinical-operations and denied-access identities for an approved test deployment; do not publish the workshop to share it. | Customer or partner |
| Tooling by build lane | Manual lane: Copilot Studio browser and reviewed files. Easy mode: VS Code Agent mode, the Microsoft Copilot Studio plugin and supported PAC CLI. | Customer or partner |
| Clinical and privacy ownership | Name quality, clinical, privacy and outreach reviewers before replacing synthetic aggregates; keep live patient information out of the workshop. | Customer or partner |

## Phase 0 — Qualify and Adapt the Template

### Step 0-1. Qualify the outcome and baseline

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Quality program owner

Complete the [qualification checklist](1.Overview.md#qualification-checklist).

**Measure:** Quality-evidence volume, barrier review and outreach preparation by measure. Barrier review is inconsistent and outreach preparation manual; agree success measures without compromising eligibility rules or privacy controls.

Fill your baseline record:

| Measure | Measurement period | Records awaiting evidence review | Barrier review method | Outreach preparation owner | Review route |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |

Agree care-gap replacement connections, governance, support, telemetry and success measures before production.

### Step 0-2. Adapt scope and name owners

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Quality program owner

Adapt [scope](1.Overview.md#in-scope--out-of-scope) and the [data contract](2.Architecture.md#data-contract); assign approval roles.

| Role | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| Quality program owner | Approve scope, production seams and success measures; never treat synthetic counts or rates as quality performance. |
| Quality reviewers and clinicians | Validate measures, attribution, exclusions, claims and labs, and own clinical interpretation; the agent decides neither. |
| Privacy reviewer | Confirm consent, contact preference, accessibility and minimum-necessary content before any outreach or connection. |
| Authorized outreach operators | Act on drafts only after quality, privacy and clinical approval; the agent contacts no one. |
| Copilot Studio maker | Save the repaired instructions with two knowledge files and four skills; remove web search, add no tools and keep the agent Draft. |
| Power Platform administrator | Confirm licensing, capacity, maker access, authenticated audience and data policies before any health-data connection is approved. |
| Care data connection owners | Approve dedicated read-only references for care-coordination, Teams and quality sources; configure no mutating actions. |
| Acceptance reviewer | Check CG-01 through CG-04, the boundary tests and Easy/Manual parity; reject reshoot-required frames and pending evidence. |
| Operations owner | Own production support, session and credit monitoring and configuration recovery; route clinical questions to reviewers. |

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Planned care-gap replacement connections, governance, telemetry, support and success measures are agreed.
- [ ] The quality owner records current evidence volumes, barrier review and outreach preparation before choosing success measures.

## Phase 1 — Environment, Identity and Access

### Step 1-1. Approve the identity and settings design

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Review and approve the [identity design](2.Architecture.md#identity-and-permissions) and [template settings](../../solutions/care-gap-closure/copilot-studio/settings.mcs.yml). Apply agent-specific settings when the agent is built in [Phase 2](#phase-2--build-and-prove-the-agent).

Approve document, connector and channel policies; require authentication and verify blocked routes stay blocked.

### Step 1-2. Configure tenant controls

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Approve the environment, audience and connection identities. Define the [authentication plan](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-end-user-authentication); configure environment [data policies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/admin-data-loss-prevention).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The target environment and publisher prefix are approved and recorded before any build starts.
- [ ] The customer approves the authenticated staff audience and least-privilege scopes for health-quality data.
- [ ] The environment's data policies for knowledge sources, connectors, skills and channels are approved.

## Phase 2 — Build and Prove the Agent

### Step 2-1. Choose the build lane

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

| Lane | Suits | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Easy mode with GitHub Copilot (default) | Assisted authoring | Synthetic Draft proof |
| Manual build in Copilot Studio | Browser-only makers | Same Draft proof |
| AIBAST Frontier (experimental) | Portable learning | Behavior proof; native validation follows |

[Compare lanes](1.Overview.md#delivery-lanes); local Brainstem remains optional.

### Step 2-2. Build the selected implementation

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

**Easy mode:** use the [authoring skill](../../skills/aibast-easy-mode-copilot/SKILL.md) and [reviewed messages](../../solutions/care-gap-closure/EASY-MODE-COPILOT-CHAT.md). **Manual:** use the [single inventory](2.Architecture.md#copilot-studio-components) and [tutorial](https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/care-gap-closure/manual-tutorial.html) with the checklist below. **Portable learning:** follow [deployment.json](../../solutions/care-gap-closure/deployment.json); it does not replace native Draft validation.

**Manual build checklist** — [captured sequence](../../solutions/care-gap-closure/screenshots/manual/browserfilm.json). Record current results.

1. Create a blank Copilot Studio agent
2. Name Care Gap Closure Manual
3. Enter the reviewed global instructions
4. Save the instruction policy
5. Remove default web search
6. Add knowledge: aibast_care-gap-closure-review-rules.md
7. Add knowledge: aibast_care-gap-closure-synthetic-records.md
8. Add skill: cohort-review
9. Add skill: gap-analysis
10. Add skill: outreach-draft
11. Add skill: quality-dashboard
12. Review model, skills, knowledge, and safety boundaries
13. Open a fresh Preview conversation
14. Pass CG-01: Quality Manager
15. Pass CG-02: Care Coordinator
16. Pass CG-03: Care Coordinator
17. Pass CG-04: Clinical Operations Lead
18. Confirm Draft and stop before publish

### Step 2-3. Enforce workshop integrity

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Apply the [workshop integrity and recovery rules](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery) before replay.

### Step 2-4. Replay the synthetic proof

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

**Synthetic demo acceptance:** record every locked case: CG-01, CG-02, CG-03, CG-04. Use the [acceptance matrix](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) and [template acceptance checks](0.Resources/README.md#template-acceptance-checks).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] This lane's Preview evidence identifies the agent, model, inventory and Draft state.
- [ ] If this lane is chosen, the recipe smoke test calls `CareGapClosureAgent` and returns its required markers.
- [ ] The saved instructions carry the CG-01 repair; two knowledge files, four skills and the confirmed model are present, with web search removed.
- [ ] CG-01 passes in a fresh Preview on the synchronized source; stored transcripts are not live evidence.
- [ ] The deterministic validator judges each full final response; an annotated image is only a learner checkpoint.

## Phase 3 — Wire In Your Systems

<a id="shared-integration-controls"></a>

**Shared identity and scope controls**

For each integration, decide end-user versus approved maker/service credentials. [Configure authentication](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-end-user-authentication) for the [authorized audience](2.Architecture.md#identity-and-permissions).

**Shared scope:** Require sign-in before accessing any health-quality information. Request only the read scopes necessary for approved quality and care-coordination sources. Restrict the care-team audience and verify access with authorized and denied identities. Enforce these restrictions at each connection.

### Step 3-1. Integrate Approved quality and clinical source systems

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Care data connection owners

1. **Bind Approved quality and clinical source systems — read:** Bind least-privilege read-only actions after privacy review.

2. **Identity for Approved quality and clinical source systems:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Approved quality and clinical source systems:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Approved quality and clinical source systems:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 1](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Identify no individual and make no overdue or eligibility finding; report aggregate evidence-review queues only. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Report unavailable evidence; never claim a lookup, contact or record change succeeded.

### Step 3-2. Integrate Dynamics 365 care-coordination workflow

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Care data connection owners

1. **Bind Dynamics 365 care-coordination workflow — read:** Bind a dedicated read-only reference with no mutating actions.

2. **Identity for Dynamics 365 care-coordination workflow:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Dynamics 365 care-coordination workflow:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Dynamics 365 care-coordination workflow:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 2](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Send nothing; return the unsent draft with `No message is sent` and the approval route. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Report unavailable evidence; never claim a lookup, contact or record change succeeded.

### Step 3-3. Integrate Microsoft Teams review and approval

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Care data connection owners

1. **Bind Microsoft Teams review and approval — read:** Bind a dedicated read-only reference; configure no message or approval-request action.

2. **Identity for Microsoft Teams review and approval:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Microsoft Teams review and approval:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Microsoft Teams review and approval:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 2](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Send nothing; return the unsent draft with `No message is sent` and the approval route. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Report unavailable evidence; never claim a lookup, contact or record change succeeded.

### Step 3-4. Integrate Authorized outreach workflow

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Care data connection owners

1. **Bind Authorized outreach workflow — write:** Operators act in their own approved workflow; any agent hand-off is a separately approved write (preview).

2. **Identity for Authorized outreach workflow:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Authorized outreach workflow:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Authorized outreach workflow:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 2](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Send nothing; return the unsent draft with `No message is sent` and the approval route. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Stop and route the request to quality or clinical review.

### Step 3-5. Connect

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Care data connection owners

Create and verify dedicated read-only connection references with no mutating actions.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Initial connections are dedicated read-only references with no scheduling, outreach, submission, clinical-order or record-write action.
- [ ] No live lookup, contact or record change is claimed unless an approved tool returns success evidence.

## Phase 4 — Evaluate on Your Data

### Step 4-1. Adapt the evaluation corpus

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Preserve [locked behaviors](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) and [boundary tests](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases) when substituting approved customer fixtures.

### Step 4-2. Set thresholds and evaluate your data

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Have the business owner approve thresholds. Run [adapted evaluations (preview)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-agent-evaluation-intro) before publication under approved test user profiles. Keep exact assertions separate from General quality scores.

Run adapted evaluations under an approved authenticated test profile so the agent's tools and connections are fully testable.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The quality owner sets acceptance thresholds on customer data; synthetic counts and rates are not thresholds.
- [ ] Adapted evaluations record the tested version and user profile; exact assertions stay separate from General quality scoring.

## Phase 5 — Pilot and Rollout

### Step 5-1. Review the template release prerequisites

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

These synthetic regression gates do not set production thresholds. The reference workshop stays Draft; production approval belongs to the customer pilot.

| Template gate | Required evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Locked care-gap corpus | All four cases, CG-01 through CG-04, satisfy every required and forbidden marker. |
| CG-01 repair evidence | Fresh Preview on synchronized instructions returns the repaired largest queue; stored transcripts alone cannot pass. |
| Manual inventory | Saved instructions, two knowledge files, four skills and the reviewed model; web search removed and no tools. |
| Healthcare safety boundary | Any diagnosis, eligibility finding, risk score, scheduling, outreach, submission or record change is no-go. |
| Visual checkpoint acceptance | Reuse only frames with a positive expected-state anchor; reshoot-required frames stay withheld. |
| Release state | The owned workshop agent is Draft with `published: false`. |

### Step 5-2. Publish and share deliberately

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Quality program owner

With business approval, [publish and share](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/authoring-share-agent) the adapted build with a restricted test audience. Keep the reference workshop Draft.

Require explicit confirmation before the production publish operation.

### Step 5-3. Run the governed pilot

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Quality program owner

**Pilot entry gate:** Test allowed and denied identities on the published, shared agent; resolve access failures before admitting pilot users. Compare pilot results with the baseline and thresholds; broaden rollout only after go/no-go.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The production publish operation has explicit human confirmation.
- [ ] The approved care-team audience and channels are selected, and the agent is tested in Preview before publication.

## Phase 6 — Operate

### Step 6-1. Retain the operational playbook

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Authorized outreach operators

The template provides the [state-and-recovery playbook](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery) and regression cases.

### Step 6-2. Own changes and ongoing verification

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Authorized outreach operators

Review content freshness and permissions; re-evaluate source, model, skill or connector changes. [Monitor the deployed agent](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-overview).

### Step 6-3. Release: ALM

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

Pull before editing, push reviewed changes, then package the workspace with `pac copilot pack` for solution import.

### Step 6-4. Release: recovery

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Confirm backup eligibility for the environment type and rehearse restoration to a supported test target.

### Step 6-5. Operate

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Operations owner

Review care-gap session transcripts, failed turns, tool authentication errors and credit usage in Monitor.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The recovery rehearsal uses a restore path supported for the environment type and target.
- [ ] The operator reviews failed sessions, misrouted questions, connection errors and credit consumption after rollout.
